answer_1.quote: We also evaluate our CohEval in narrative text generation, with CohEval as coherence guidance... We conduct an ablation experiment to explore the impact of different sub-modules in contrastive narratives generation.
answer_1.outputs: generated narratives and counterfactual story endings

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation metrics include BLEU4, BertScore, ENTScore, and HMean=2·BLEU4·ENTScore... Table 2 shows the automatic result on TimeTravel.

answer_4.quote: We perform an A/B test to compare our method with several baselines. Three annotators are recruited to make a preference among win, tie, and lose given the counterfactual context and two outputs by our model and a baseline respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare each pair of outputs and indicate a win, tie, or lose based on predefined criteria.
